text: Regulatory uncertainty produces a chilling effect: because early adopters must apply traditional law to novel instruments and cannot reach a comfortable level of certainty, legacy businesses hold back from adoption.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
abstract: As a result, there is a chilling effect over the industry where legacy businesses are weary to adopt because of regulatory uncertainty.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: current U.S. regulatory climate for tokens and digital securities
